name: Data Structures & Algorithms
short_description: Master algorithmic complexity, memory representation, and classic data structures.
description: Comprehensive curriculum covering algorithmic complexity analysis, linear structures, trees, graphs, dynamic programming, and optimization techniques.

courses.title: Data Structures & Algorithms Core
courses.description: In-depth study of memory layout, algorithmic analysis, and problem-solving strategies.

modules.title: Complexity Analysis
modules.description: Asymptotic bounds, time-space trade-offs, and recurrence relations.

topics.title: Big-O, Big-Omega & Theta Notations
topics.summary: Mathematical definitions of asymptotic upper, lower, and tight bounds.

topics.title: Space Complexity & Memory Trade-offs
topics.summary: Evaluating auxiliary memory allocations versus computational runtime.

topics.title: Amortized Analysis
topics.summary: Analyzing average time per operation across a worst-case sequence.

modules.title: Arrays
modules.description: Contiguous memory structures, multi-dimensional addressing, and linear scanning.

topics.title: Static vs Dynamic Arrays
topics.summary: Contiguous storage, resizing amortized cost, and index arithmetic.

topics.title: Sliding Window & Two-Pointers
topics.summary: Subarray scanning techniques for linear algorithmic optimizations.

modules.title: Strings
modules.description: Character encoding, immutable buffer operations, and substring indexing.

topics.title: String Manipulation & Encodings
topics.summary: ASCII, UTF-8 buffer layouts and in-place transformations.

topics.title: Pattern Matching Basics
topics.summary: Naive and KMP prefix functions for string search.

modules.title: Linked Lists
modules.description: Node pointer structures, dynamic allocation, and non-contiguous collections.

topics.title: Singly & Doubly Linked Lists
topics.summary: Pointer manipulation, head/tail sentinels, and node insertion/deletion.

topics.title: Fast & Slow Pointer Techniques
topics.summary: Cycle detection (Floyd's algorithm) and middle node retrieval.

modules.title: Stacks
modules.description: LIFO abstract data type, call stack simulation, and parenthetical parsing.

topics.title: Stack ADT & Implementations
topics.summary: Array-backed vs node-backed LIFO containers.

topics.title: Monotonic Stacks & Parentheses
topics.summary: Monotonic stacks for next-greater element and expression evaluation.

modules.title: Queues
modules.description: FIFO sequencing, ring buffers, and deque implementations.

topics.title: Circular Queues & Deque
topics.summary: Modulo index pointer wrapping and double-ended queues.

topics.title: Priority Queues Overview
topics.summary: Ordered retrieval using heap structures.

modules.title: Hashing
modules.description: Direct addressing, hash collision resolution, and hash table sizing.

topics.title: Hash Functions & Collision Handling
topics.summary: Separate chaining, open addressing, and load factor thresholding.

modules.title: Trees
modules.description: Hierarchical structures, tree traversals, and balance guarantees.

topics.title: Binary Tree Traversals
topics.summary: Pre-order, In-order, Post-order, and Level-order BFS visits.

topics.title: Binary Search Trees (BST)
topics.summary: Ordering invariants, logarithmic lookups, and deletions.

topics.title: Balanced Search Trees (AVL & Red-Black)
topics.summary: Height balance, rotations, and the O(log n) guarantee of AVL and red-black trees.

topics.title: Tries & Prefix Search
topics.summary: Character-indexed trees for prefix queries, autocomplete, and dictionary lookups.

modules.title: Heaps
modules.description: Complete binary trees with heap properties for priority management.

topics.title: Min & Max Heap Implementation
topics.summary: Array-backed complete trees, sift-up, and sift-down operations.

modules.title: Graphs
modules.description: Vertices, edges, traversal algorithms, and shortest paths.

topics.title: Graph Representations
topics.summary: Adjacency matrix vs adjacency list space-time comparison.

topics.title: Breadth-First Search & Depth-First Search
topics.summary: Queue-driven BFS and recursive DFS cycle detection.

topics.title: Shortest Paths: Dijkstra & Bellman-Ford
topics.summary: Single-source shortest paths with non-negative and with negative edge weights.

topics.title: Minimum Spanning Trees & Disjoint Sets
topics.summary: Kruskal's and Prim's algorithms and the union-find structure behind Kruskal.

modules.title: Searching
modules.description: Sequential scanning and binary partitioning search strategies.

topics.title: Binary Search & Invariants
topics.summary: Half-interval elimination on monotonic domains.

modules.title: Sorting
modules.description: Quadratic, logarithmic, and linear time sorting algorithms.

topics.title: Elementary & Linear-Time Sorting
topics.summary: Insertion, selection, and bubble sort, the comparison lower bound, and counting and radix sort.

topics.title: Merge Sort & QuickSort
topics.summary: Divide-and-conquer partitioning, pivot selection, and stability.

modules.title: Recursion
modules.description: Self-referential functions, base cases, and activation call frames.

topics.title: Call Stack & Recurrence Trees
topics.summary: Stack frame unwinding and Master Theorem analysis.

topics.title: Backtracking
topics.summary: Systematic search with pruning: subsets, permutations, and N-Queens.

modules.title: Greedy Algorithms
modules.description: Local optimal choice heuristics and correctness proofs.

topics.title: Greedy Choice & Optimal Substructure
topics.summary: Interval scheduling and fractional knapsack problem solving.

modules.title: Dynamic Programming
modules.description: Optimal substructure, overlapping subproblems, memoization, and tabulation.

topics.title: Memoization vs Tabulation
topics.summary: Top-down recursive caching vs bottom-up iterative DP table construction.

topics.title: 0/1 Knapsack Problem
topics.summary: State transition equation and 2D DP matrix space optimization.
